name: Rhythm Ball Revolution!
description: A letter from the People of the Springs beckons you and Paimon to a special party hosted by Mualani. It's time to take the stage...

steps.description: Go to the People of the Springs

dialogs.content: Hey!
Our guests of honor are here! Now we can really get this party started!
Hey, Mualani! Oh, and Xilonen's here too!
And... Mizuki? You're back from Inazuma already!
That's right! My friends in Natlan are like family to me. I like to think of the People of the Springs as my home away from home.
If I want to help people here, I definitely can't neglect the Natlan branch of my practice.
Miss Mizuki's work ethic is impeccable.
She puts the rest of us service-providers to shame...
Wait, so... Are you one of her clients, too?
Well, I've had some weird dreams lately... Like, a client expediting a commission from a four-week time-frame to just one.
Or, like a rush order for some kind of spherical accessory with an element of danger to it...
I know this one. Slimes and Fungi.
Wow, you made that connection pretty fast, Traveler. Almost as if you're the one sending Xilonen weird commissions through her dreams...
Huh, are those creatures... dangerous?
Anyway, the expedited time frame isn't even the hardest part. Spherical designs are tricky, and when you rush it, you end up with something that isn't even good.
Point being, I've been having nothing but those kinds of dreams. So, I wrapped up all my orders and decided to visit Miss Mizuki for help...
And, it worked like a charm! When I took a nap that afternoon, all the weird dreams were gone!
It was my pleasure to help, Miss Xilonen.
Although, I'm not sure how much credit I can really take for the disappearance of those dreams...
In any case, everyone's feeling good and well-rested now! Which means, it's party time!
A party on the water, to be exact! It's a tradition in my tribe, and we're gonna have a blast!
A party on the water, huh...
Yeah! Let's party!
...Although, what does that involve, exactly? Obviously, delicious food and drinks are a given...
But, how do people in Natlan like to party?
High-speed surfing with a Koholasaur?
Wait... Are you being serious?
Oho, do I spy a fellow extreme sports enthusiast!? To tell you the truth, those activities were where my mind first went to as well!
But, according to Chief Amina... *ahem*... "Not everyone likes high-adrenaline activities!"
"Even beach volleyball can be dangerous. It's all fun and games until you spike the ball straight into your friend!"
"This event is supposed to be fun, not something that scars people and creates even more work for Miss Mizuki in the process!"
Well, she does have a point. I'm always happy to help, but I'd rather not have a hand in creating my own patients' trauma. It's better if no one gets hurt.
Mhm-hmm, which is why I came to you for advice!
So, what's the plan?
Well, not everyone has a background in extreme sports, and we don't want that to deter people from participating in this event.
As we were chatting, I happened to mention the Mikawa Flower Festival and its more laid-back approach to games, and Miss Mualani really latched onto that idea.
So, we decided to give Akitsu Haneasobi a distinctive Natlanese twist! The result is "Rhythm Ball" — a relaxing game that doesn't sacrifice on fun.
An Inazuman game... with a Natlanese twist! What a cool idea!
There's the Children of Echoes' Dance-Off Stage.
Wow, and you haven't even heard the band at full volume! You must have a good sense of rhythm...
Which, as you can imagine, is perfect for "Rhythm Ball." The goal is to smash all the blocks by hitting the balls to the beat of the music.
No complex techniques, no safety issues, just instinct. It's a game everyone can enjoy.
Oh, of course, with your skill, you could even add extra layers to the music, or bring out a new sense of rhythm.
After all, different DJs can give the same song a whole new feel. And, in a game that involves beats, the player can showcase that same creativity!
Who knows... In your hands, the background track could go from an easy-listening, chill-out piece to something with a trance or artcore twist!
I can't wait to see what you come up with.
#Uh-huh, yeah, whatever you say... Well, sounds like something you can do, right, {NICKNAME}?
Yeah, music and games! Right up my alley!
Yes! That's the spirit! As long as you and Paimon can play your hearts out, it's mission accomplished!
Oh, and I'll grab some snacks and drinks for the rest of us while we watch!
Just remember to pace yourself, okay, Traveler?
I'm sure you don't want an endless loop of Dance-Off Stage music stuck in your head before bed tonight.
Well, thanks, everyone! This sounds like a blast!
Plus, if Xilonen's the one DJ-ing, an endless loop of music in our dreams... doesn't sound too bad!
Sure! I'll give it my best shot!
I can really feel the beat of the music.
Skydiving from the back of a Qucusaur?
Rope-less bungee jumping with a Yumkasaur... Tried that one, actually.
Sounds fun.
Are you talking about Specters and Ball Octopuses?
Or could it be... that you've worked together before?
